title: Bar Salts Blue Razz Lemonade Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Blue Razz Lemonade flavour concentrate blends the tangy sweetness of blue raspberry with the sharp citrus notes of fresh lemonade flavours. This flavour concentrate offers a perfect mix for those who enjoy a sharp, citrusy edge in their vape, combined with the sweet undertones of blue raspberry. Embark on your own DIY e-liquid adventure with Bar Salts’ premium quality flavour concentrates. This 30ml bottle is perfect for vapers who love to craft their own e-liquid, and provides a 100% PG Based flavour shot to add to a VG/PG Base Mix + Nic Shots (optional). Whether you’re dabbling in DIY mixing for the first time or you’re an experienced vape juice mixologist, Bar Salts’ Blue Razz Lemonade Flavour Concentrate serves as the ideal foundation for creating your own e-liquid, your way. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
